subject: Next steps: finalizing payment route & invoice format for CarbonStack
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@carbonstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: payment route & invoice format (quick recap)

Amy — thanks for the time earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can land procurement next week: 

- Commercial path: CarbonStack prefers a PO-driven purchase if possible, but Amy said the card route is an acceptable short-term option for pilot. Can you confirm internal threshold for PO mandate (e.g., >$10k/month)?
- Invoice requirements: Finance needs a vendor name exactly as it should appear on invoices, a billing address, and whether VAT reversal applies (you mentioned EU customers but CarbonStack is US-headquartered).
- Net terms: You mentioned 30 days standard, finance may request net-45 for first year. Please confirm the point person.

Attachments: I’m attaching the draft SOW and a short checklist of fields Finance typically requires. If you can confirm the PO flow and send any internal PO-template PDF, we’ll route procurement with our ops team.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Marissa (billing ops) to capture the exact invoice format we should send. Would love to have your procurement contact (or finance@carbonstack.com) on a brief 20-minute call Monday to finalize.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (docx), CarbonStack_PO_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@carbonstack.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@carbonstack.com
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: payment route & invoice format (quick recap)

Thanks Sergio — great meeting. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PO policy: We require POs for any vendor relationship where monthly spend is expected to exceed $7,500. For a short pilot under that, card is fine.
- Finance contact: please include finance@carbonstack.com on any invoice discussions. I’m copying them here.
- Invoice fields: We need vendor EIN on the invoice and a billing address (I’ll paste our template below). VAT not applicable for us (US entity).
- Net terms: Finance typically accepts NET30. For pilots they prefer NET30; NET45 will need Director approval.

Internal billing template (copy/paste):
Company name:	CarbonStack Inc.
Billing address:	88 Market St, Suite 220, San Francisco, CA 94105
PO number:	PO-XXXXX
Tax ID (EIN):	93-1234567
Contact for remittance:	accounts-payable@carbonstack.com

I’ll confirm if procurement wants a DocuSign PO or a PDF PO export from Coupa. If procurement chooses Coupa, we’ll need vendor setup details (W-9, remit address, and contact).

—Amy
Amy Liu
Head of Partnerships | CarbonStack
amy.liu@carbonstack.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@carbonstack.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps: payment route & invoice format (quick recap)

Hi Amy — looping in Billing Ops (Ben and I) to align on the exact invoice payload we’ll produce. Quick answers and requests from our side: 

- Vendor/Invoice name: We will invoice as "Redwood Inference, Inc." and include our EIN: 81-6543210. That will appear in the invoice header. Confirm ok.
- Billing address options: Our standard remit address is 120 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107. If CarbonStack needs the billing address to match vendor-registration in Coupa, confirm which address to use.
- PO vs card: If you do a pilot under $7.5k/mo then we can accept the card. If you convert to a committed seat/pool and cross the threshold we’ll require PO and will provide a PO-ready PDF (or do vendor setup for Coupa).
- Invoice format: We can provide a PDF invoice that includes line-level usage, tax/EIN, PO number field, and remittance instructions. If you need any additional fields (cost center, project code), please list them.

Action items: 
1) Amy / finance to confirm whether they want a DocuSign PO, Coupa PO, or simple PDF PO for the pilot.
2) CarbonStack to confirm billing address to display on the invoice.
3) If Coupa onboarding is required, finance to share vendor setup contact and W-9.

I’ve attached a short invoice sample and the SOW Sergio sent. Ben — can you propose standard NET terms for pilot customers? We typically default NET30.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing & Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: CarbonStack_PO_requirements.pdf (pdf), Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@carbonstack.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps: payment route & invoice format (quick recap)

Amy — thanks for the details. NET30 is fine for the pilot. A couple of operational notes from Finance: 

- If CarbonStack wants NET45 for the first year we can escalate but it will need Director approval and a signed SOW showing the commitment level.
- For Coupa vendor setup we’ll need: W-9, remit address, bank wiring instructions (if they want wires), and a primary AP contact. Please send to vendor-setup@redwood.com.
- We will include EIN and line-level usage on the PDF invoice; please confirm whether you want hourly/daily breakdowns or a single monthly usage summary. For pilots we usually do monthly summary unless you need runtime breakdowns.

Proposed next step: 20-minute call Wednesday to finalize PO format and confirm whether Coupa onboarding is needed. If you prefer, we can accept card for the pilot and do Coupa onboarding only upon expansion.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0147
